method.definition_of_mature: Public SKILL.md from an official, established, or demonstrably maintained repository; a clear creative workflow; repository-level maintenance and license reviewed; unique behavior must survive comparison with the existing capability graph.
searches: GitHub repository search across agent skills, Claude skills, design, frontend, presentation, video, image, diagram, game, 3D, audio and music
GitHub code search for SKILL.md across ten media-specific queries, up to 100 results per query
recursive SKILL.md tree enumeration of official and high-signal repositories
awesome-agent-skill indexes used only for discovery; primary repositories rechecked directly
selected SKILL.md files read from the authenticated GitHub Contents API
method.coverage_boundary: GitHub is continuously changing and code search is not mathematically exhaustive. This registry covers the mature official/high-signal public skill ecosystems found in the live search; ordinary tool repositories remain in ecosystem-catalog.json rather than being mislabeled as agent skills.
method.adoption_rule: Absorb behavior into the narrowest constitution/capability/evidence layer. Never bulk-install an upstream repository or copy license-unclear prose. Tool-specific commands remain adapters, not design authority.

absorbed_behaviors: choose a specific aesthetic thesis before implementation
treat brand rules as semantic constraints rather than decoration
progressively disclose large references and keep editable source plus rendered proof
separate document/deck mechanics from the audience-facing design decision
inspect a real browser artifact instead of trusting source code
rejected_assumptions: programmatic shapes are sufficient art direction
an upstream skill's house style should become the umbrella default

absorbed_behaviors: keep design-system rules, generated direction and implementation as distinct handoffs
use screenshots as evidence attached to the exact artifact state
distinguish raster-generation mechanics from creative authority
preserve editable source and output-format verification
rejected_assumptions: Figma or a particular image provider is always available

absorbed_behaviors: translate vague taste into semantic axes such as atmosphere, density, variance and motion
make the design contract portable between generated design, source code and a maintained design system
keep existing code/design sources as evidence rather than restarting from prompts
separate generated concepts from implementation adapters
treat code-to-design and design-to-code as a round trip with source-of-truth ownership
rejected_assumptions: one accent color, one font ban, constant animation or any other taste constant is universally mature
Stitch is required for the workflow

absorbed_behaviors: detect generic UI defaults as symptoms of absent product reasoning rather than as a style blacklist
compare rendered evidence with a reference and report concrete visible deltas
retain editable native sources for diagrams, vectors and 3D
name layers, canvases and outputs for inspectable handoff
separate image, diagram, CAD and engine mechanics from final-user direction
rejected_assumptions: a gallery of effects or component recipes constitutes premium design

record architectural decisions separately from user-facing documentation
keep interface contracts explicit across behavior and presentation
derive visual structure from information structure before choosing style
persist final prompts and reference roles before rendering for reproducibility
preserve exact data and separate source analysis, structured content, prompt and output
use reference images explicitly as subject, palette, style or composition evidence

batch independent renders while keeping per-artifact source records
rejected_assumptions: a fixed layout-style matrix should decide the direction before user/product intent
image-backed slides are always preferable to native editable slides
confirmation is mandatory when the user has already delegated autonomous production

absorbed_behaviors: treat framework and editor compatibility as adapter concerns

route WebGPU/Three.js work through a spatial capability rather than a frontend visual-effects default

absorbed_behaviors: keep create, import, modify and manage operations distinct around one design source
make timeline source, rendered frames and final media separately inspectable
compose multiple creative mechanics under one artifact direction

absorbed_behaviors: choose a data encoding and interaction model before styling
offer a nonvisual data alternative and semantic accessibility text

mandatory attribution or update behavior can be copied without license and product review
